help.command.proc: Background processes the agent started with @proc: list, status <id>, logs <id> [--grep <re>] [--tail N], stop <id>
proc.cmd.usage: Usage: /proc list · /proc status <id> · /proc logs <id> [--grep <regexp>] [--tail N] · /proc stop <id>. Processes are started by the agent (@proc start); here you watch them and stop them.
proc.cmd.none_tracked: No background processes. The agent starts them with @proc when a server or watcher must keep running.
proc.cmd.bad_tail: Invalid --tail %q: use a number from 1 to %d.
proc.cmd.grep_header: --- %d of %d matching line(s) shown, %d lines total ---
complete.proc.list: Every background process of this session
complete.proc.status: State, pid, uptime and exit code of one process
complete.proc.logs: Last lines of a process's output (--grep, --tail)
complete.proc.stop: Terminate a process and its children
complete.proc.grep: Only the lines matching a regexp (case-insensitive)
complete.proc.tail: How many lines to show (default 100, max 1000)
help.command.taskgraph: Task graph runs: plan <file>, run <file|id>, retry [id] [task], status [id], show <task> [id], list, dash, prune, cancel
taskgraph.usage.title: /taskgraph — plan, run and observe task graph runs
taskgraph.usage.body: plan <file.json> · run <file.json|run-id> · retry [run-id] [task-id] · status [id] · show <task> [id] · list · dash [id] · prune [30d|all] · cancel — run and retry start in the background and return at once: follow them with /taskgraph status. Tasks only count as done after the engine's validation gate and an independent reviewer verdict.
complete.taskgraph.plan: Validate and save a plan file without running it
complete.taskgraph.run: Run a plan file (or a saved run) in the background
complete.taskgraph.retry: Re-open a failed task and resume the run in the background
taskgraph.cmd.plan_accepted: Plan accepted: run %s (%d tasks). Start it with /taskgraph run %s
taskgraph.cmd.run_started: Run %s started in the background. Nobody is at the prompt for it, so an action that needs approval is denied, not asked (unless /policy automode admits it). Follow it with /taskgraph status %s (or /taskgraph dash); stop it with /taskgraph cancel.
taskgraph.cmd.background_busy: Run %s is still going in the background. Wait for it (/taskgraph status) or stop it (/taskgraph cancel) first.
taskgraph.cmd.background_canceled: Cancellation of background run %s requested; check /taskgraph status.
taskgraph.cmd.cancel_requested: Cancellation requested; tasks end when they observe the signal.
taskgraph.cmd.pruned_all: Removed %d run(s): everything but the active run.
taskgraph.cmd.dash: Task graph dashboard: %s (read-only; closing it never affects the run)
taskgraph.cmd.file_required: /taskgraph %s needs one plan file (JSON), e.g. /taskgraph %[1]s plan.json
taskgraph.err.no_dispatcher: The task graph needs the agent's workers, which exist only after /coder or /agent has run in this session.
taskgraph.err.retry_pick: Run %s has %d failed task(s) [%s]: name the one to retry (/taskgraph retry <run-id> <task-id>).
taskgraph.err.retry_not_failed: Task %s is %s; only failed tasks can be retried.
taskgraph.err.busy: A run is already active in this session: cancel it or wait.
taskgraph.err.no_runs: No runs yet. Create one with /taskgraph plan <file.json> or /taskgraph run <file.json>.
chan.cmd.unknown_word: %q is neither a /channel subcommand nor a channel the inbox knows. Subcommands: list, unread, inject, ack, clear, pause, resume, rules, confirm, run.
chan.cmd.bad_limit: Invalid --limit %q: use a number from 1 up.
chan.cmd.clear_bad_arg: /channel clear takes only --all (got %q). Nothing was cleared.
chan.cmd.suggest_unread: Only the messages received since the last ack
plugins.channels.unknown_cmd: @channels: unknown subcommand %q — use list, unread, rules or ack
moa.cmd.flags_usage: Per run: --models a,b:model,c (no spaces) · --aggregator <provider[:model]> · --positions lead|full|off · -- ends the flags, for a prompt that starts with dashes · /moa list shows the providers that can take part.
complete.moa.models: Panel members for this run: provider or provider:model, comma-separated
complete.moa.aggregator: Model that synthesizes this run's answer
complete.moa.positions: How much of each member's answer to show: lead, full or off
proc.cmd.stopping: Stopping %s (TERM now, KILL if it does not exit). Check /proc status %s.
proc.cmd.pipes_abandoned: killed, but a child that left its process group still holds the output and may still be running
moa.cmd.unknown_flag: /moa does not know the flag %s. If your prompt itself starts with dashes, put -- before it: /moa -- --your prompt
moa.cmd.models_trailing_comma: --models %q ends with a comma: write the list without spaces (a,b,c).
